description: Convert a graph into Spaces — the bounded faces of the network. Min area drops noise faces (text boxes, hatching). Single → all spaces on one endpoint; per space → one endpoint each.
instructions:
Extracts the bounded FACES of an incoming graph (polylines) as closed Space polygons — it fetches the spaces from the graph's topology. `minArea` (m²) drops noise faces (text boxes, hatching, dimension loops). `outputMode` = single (all spaces on one endpoint, default) or perCell (one endpoint per space).

Also publishes `val-spaces` (count) + `val-totalArea` (m²) for an Output node. This is the key step in the raster→spaces recipe: Image → Vectorise → Graph to Spaces.
